summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned WhatsApp phone mockup on the homepage 'Önce sorun' section plus the commitments copy update. The phone mockup renders inside data-testid='landing-ask-first' with an authentic WhatsApp look (green header #075E54, wallpaper #EFEAE2 with subtle dotted pattern, right-aligned #D9FDD3 outgoing bubbles with blue double-tick, left-aligned white incoming bubbles with tails, 'Bugün' date divider, 'Mesaj yazın' input, round green mic FAB linking to wa.me/905325882630). All 7 bubbles (wa-bubble-0..6) render with opacity 1 after scroll+wait, all required dialogue content is present (7-ay pasaport, 6-ay geçerlilik, image bubble with '/chat/passport-shot.jpg' returning 200, '2 yetişkin 1 çocuk', 58 gün + aile indirimi, PDF card 'Vize_Onay_DV-8421.pdf 212 KB · 1 sayfa'). Alignment (out=flex-end, in=flex-start) verified; phone bounding box 368x860 on desktop with last bubble fully inside. ask-first-note, 3 timeline badges, WhatsApp+Başvuru CTAs, and CommitmentsStrip copy ('90 gün, sonra içerik imha edilir', 'Belgelerinizin içeriği 90 gün sonra imha ediliyor', no 'otomatik silinir') all pass. HOWEVER: a critical UI bug - the WhatsAppIcon inside data-testid='ask-first-note' is being sized with invalid Tailwind class 'h-4.5 w-4.5', which Tailwind does not recognize, so the SVG has no width/height and expands to fill its parent (472x472px on desktop, dominating the note card on mobile/tablet). This also causes horizontal scroll overflow on both 390 (scrollWidth 453) and 768 (scrollWidth 823) viewports - the mobile-no-h-overflow acceptance criterion FAILS as a direct consequence.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid Tailwind class 'h-4.5 w-4.5' on <WhatsAppIcon>. WhatsAppIcon.jsx's inline <svg> has no intrinsic width/height attributes, so the icon expands to fill the flex container and renders at ~472x472px on desktop, and takes up the full width of the note box on mobile/tablet (see screenshots). Also causes horizontal page overflow at 390px (scrollWidth 453) and 768px (scrollWidth 823).

issues: Because of the giant WhatsApp icon (see ui bug above), the note text is squeezed to the right on desktop and appears below a huge black glyph on mobile - looks broken.

Subjective read on the phone mock itself: authenticity is good - header colour (#075E54), bubble tails, ticks (blue double-check), wallpaper dots, and input bar with mic FAB read as a genuine WhatsApp chat. Nothing off-brand inside the phone.

action_items: Fix WhatsAppIcon sizing in AskFirstSection.jsx line 88: replace 'h-4.5 w-4.5' with a valid Tailwind size (e.g. 'h-5 w-5' or 'h-4 w-4'). This alone will also resolve the mobile/tablet horizontal-overflow failure.

Grep for any other 'h-4.5' / 'w-4.5' classes; the WhatsAppPhoneMock uses them on lucide-react icons which happen to work because lucide sets intrinsic width=24 height=24, but they still don't apply Tailwind sizing - consider standardising to h-4/h-5.
critical_code_review_comments: h-4.5 / w-4.5 are not valid stock Tailwind utilities and are silently dropped; use h-4/h-5 or extend theme.spacing in tailwind.config.js.
WhatsAppIcon SVG lacks default width/height attributes - safer to add width='1em' height='1em' as a fallback so a bad className cannot blow it up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything about the phone mockup itself (structure, content, bubbles, animation, alignment, PDF card, wa.me href, image asset 200) is correct. Only the sibling 'ask-first-note' icon sizing is broken. Re-run the mobile 390 and tablet 768 no-horizontal-overflow assertion after the fix - it should then pass. The 3 steps, CTAs, and CommitmentsStrip copy already pass and don't need re-verification.
rca of the issue: AskFirstSection.jsx sets <WhatsAppIcon className='mt-0.5 h-4.5 w-4.5 shrink-0' />. Tailwind v3 does not ship an h-4.5/w-4.5 utility and no such value is added to tailwind.config.js theme.extend.spacing. The classes are therefore ignored at build time. Because WhatsAppIcon's inline SVG has no fallback width/height attribute, it renders at its default block-flex size and stretches to the note's row height (472px). The oversized icon in turn pushes the flex row past the viewport width, producing the mobile/tablet horizontal-scroll failure.
